191.unitary_invariance_theorem: On each simple block M_d, invariance under all inner unitaries forces the density matrix I_d/d. On a direct sum it leaves a probability vector on the centre.
191.tensor_compatibility: simple-block normalized traces satisfy tau_d tensor tau_e = tau_{de}; central weights tensor multiplicatively as w_i v_j
191.minimal_missing_datum: a probability measure on the centre, or an additional naturality/Morita principle that fixes it
191.status: Reference-state classification theorem; central source remains open
191.claim_boundary: Normalized trace is unique on a simple matrix algebra, not on a non-simple direct sum. Neither 9/5 nor 17/9 is promoted to a strict temperature or physical state source.

192.status: Scale quotient constructed; invariant bridge mismatch remains
192.confidence: Proven quotient theorem; numerical profile integral
192.claim_boundary: The quotient attacks one compression-scale atom only. It does not source eta, omega, phi, complete the bridge or transfer legacy physical roles.

196.theorem: Conditional on R recorded refreshes, the retained values are iid F and DKW holds with epsilon(R,delta)=sqrt(log(2/delta)/(2R)). Mixing over the random R preserves the failure bound.
196.status: Nonasymptotic theorem executed for an explicit beta-mixing acquisition class
196.confidence: Proven conditional theorem; strong numerical coverage evidence
196.claim_boundary: Refresh flags are an acquisition assumption. Hidden general beta-mixing requires a different coupling or concentration theorem.

197.status: Frozen order-sensitive protocol executed on six synthetic challenges
197.confidence: Strong synthetic evidence; exact multiset identity
197.claim_boundary: The detector distinguishes declared temporal alternatives. It is not a universal open-set classifier, memory theorem or external experimental validation.

198.minimality_theorem: In the declared three-parameter family, fewer than three scalar contrasts have Jacobian rank at most two. The single/plus/echo matrix has determinant -1 and identifies all three parameters.
198.status: Minimal rank theorem and finite-noise tomography executed
198.confidence: Proven rank/minimality in declared family; strong synthetic evidence
198.claim_boundary: Gaussian equal-variance increments and multiplicative detector blur are explicit model assumptions, not strict FIN consequences.

constructed_object.name: OperationalEnvironmentQuotient
constructed_object.equivalence: two environments are k-equivalent when all preparation/intervention/measurement probabilities in the declared k-step experiment agree
constructed_object.minimal_dilation_rule: minimal Stinespring dilations of one channel are unique only up to an environment isometry

199.finite_identifiability_theorem: A finite set of observed characteristic-function values defines a finite-dimensional affine image of the probability-measure simplex; generally its fibres contain multiple microscopic phase laws. Only quotient data, not microscopic coordinates, are operationally identifiable.
199.status: Explicit environment quotient and one-time nonidentifiability witness
199.claim_boundary: Process tomography can refine the quotient but finite data do not identify an arbitrary environment distribution or dilation.

200.endomorphism_theorem: Every continuous group endomorphism U(1)->U(1) is z->z^n. It maps the order-eight legacy phase to a root of unity, whereas exp(i*743/4000) is transcendental by Lindemann--Weierstrass.

201.claim_boundary: The catalogue supports scale-free falsification only. A physical clock or scale-charged source remains additional CA or new strict input.

202.status: Synthetic intake dry run passes 10/11; independent external boundary fails
202.claim_boundary: The generated event record validates the intake and analysis machinery only. It is not external evidence and cannot validate physics.
